title: Charles S NDE 22034
content: First: I was five years old, sitting atop an electric pole looking down at mother huddled over me and yelling for me to wake up. Second: I was shaving in the bathroom and I thought that I could be running late for an appointment. I suddenly found myself in the bedroom hovering over the bed, looking at the clock and thinking. When I was like this, I could see perfectly without my glasses. I had plenty of time and went back to shave. I looked in the mirror and knew that I had just had an out of body experience. No question about it. I wish I could do it again. But I can’t. Not now.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: No 1 fell off porch. 2 happy getting ready to go out
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes The experience was cerebral. I did not see my body outside of my body. I could see other things but not myself outside of my body.
elements.At what time during the experience were: On one hand, I was apparently out. On the other, I was wide awake and sharp as a tack.
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes One: my front yard. Two: my bed and clock.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm It wasn't different.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I returned to please my mother.
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I returned to please my mother. God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.What is your religion now?: Liberal everlasting born again pagan or heathen in a pinch
elements.After the NDE: eligion now? Liberal everlasting born again pagan or heathen in a pinch After the NDE
elements.Are there any other questions that we co: My feeling is that the essence that exists out of the body during these episodes is not nothing. If it is something, when will we be able to measure it? I would like to see a study where people dying are observed with some super high-tech electromagnetic wave recorder to determine if the brain waves might leave and could be followed to see what happens to them. To me NOTHING can achieve an out of body experience. It has to be something, and if it is something, it should be capable of being measured!
